note: For each position i define I_i as the maximum length of a strictly increasing subsequence ending at i and D_i analogously for decreasing. If neither requested subsequence exists, all I_i,D_i lie in {1,...,n}. For i<j, distinctness gives either a_i<a_j, forcing I_j>=I_i+1, or a_i>a_j, forcing D_j>=D_i+1. Thus the n^2+1 labels (I_i,D_i) are pairwise distinct but only n^2 labels exist. Contradiction. This directly proves the exact target without external results or predecessor facts.
